what_this_is: What the vendor's own public pages state about the per-frame active-manipulation figure, copied from the pages on the retrieval date. Nothing here is measured by this project.

corpus_page.note: gated; the facts below are from the page text as retrieved, not from the files

sampling_sentence: we randomly sample 10k frames from each dataset and run them through a gemini-2.5-flash
prompt_task: determine whether the camera-wearer is actively manipulating an object at this exact moment
definition: "Active Manpulation" means the wearer is visibly using their hands to work on, modify, assemble, process, or handle physical objects, materials, components in pursuit of a specific goal
rules: Do not infer actions that are not visible in the frame.
If the action is ambiguous or not clearly happening, respond "no."
Ignore objects held by other people.

sibling_audit.what_this_is: Numbers quoted from the abstract of the author's own sibling audit of the same published figures. They are not measured in this repository and cannot be re-derived here; the source is the cited paper.
sibling_audit.citation: Theodoro, C. Asymmetric Judge Error and Clustered Frames. Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.24453957
